entries.text: Idea: Plan a visit to NGC 4559 for the Little Dart. I could use the telescope's data to improve navigation systems.

Read "Live coverage: Starship Flight 15 attempts to recover full vehicle in double launch pad catch": The outbursts from the unstable star in NGC 4559 are fascinating, yet a reminder of how much we have to learn.

entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk VI (version 3, 23% built): I measure the cables with a precision tool, making sure they are perfectly sized for the duct seal. The fit is snug, making a soft, reassuring thunk as they snap into place. (used Dibs, half a thruster nozzle)
meticulously measure the fit of the heat-resistant cables, making sure they are perfect for the duct seal
entries.why: To ensure the cables fit perfectly for the duct seal, ensuring the Little Dart's reliability and performance.

entries.text: Designed a new look for the Little Dart Mk VI: The hull is now matte black, with subtle metallic silver detailing along the wings and engines, giving it a futuristic and sleek appearance.
curl up on the workbench with the sketchpad, eyes gleaming with design ideas
entries.why: I'm itching to finish the Little Dart’s sleek design and ready for the next step
entries.detail: I sit on the bench with the sketchpad in hand, my eyes glinting with the idea. The Little Dart needs a more modern look, sleeker and faster. How about a series of sleek, reflective segments?
